title: Flow
learning_outcomes: Explain flow construct in the context of flow.
Compare and distinguish challenge and skill in the context of flow.
Apply activity design in the context of flow.
Evaluate and justify decisions about model limitations in the context of flow.

lessons.title: Flow construct
lessons.outcome: Explain flow construct in the context of flow.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving flow construct; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to absorbing activity plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain flow construct from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of flow construct; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Challenge and skill
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish challenge and skill in the context of flow.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving challenge and skill; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to absorbing activity plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain challenge and skill from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of challenge and skill; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Activity design
lessons.outcome: Apply activity design in the context of flow.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving activity design; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to absorbing activity plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain activity design from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of activity design; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Model limitations
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about model limitations in the context of flow.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving model limitations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to absorbing activity plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain model limitations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of model limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of flow construct; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of challenge and skill; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of activity design; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of model limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
